## 4.1 Ocean Dynamics and Governing Equations

### Navier-Stokes and the Lid-Driven Cavity

The incompressible Navier-Stokes equations govern fluid motion:

$$\frac{\partial \mathbf{u}}{\partial t} + (\mathbf{u} \cdot \nabla)\mathbf{u} = -\frac{\nabla p}{\rho} + \nu \nabla^2 \mathbf{u}, \qquad \nabla \cdot \mathbf{u} = 0$$

The Reynolds number $\text{Re} = UL/\nu$ measures inertia vs viscosity. The classic **lid-driven cavity** problem illustrates these equations: a square box with a moving lid drives a recirculating flow. We solve it using **Chorin's projection method** (fractional step).

```{julia}
#| eval: false

using Plots

N  = 41;  L = 1.0;  Re = 100.0;  U = 1.0
ν  = U * L / Re
dx = L / (N - 1);  dy = dx
dt = min(0.25 * dx^2 / ν, 0.25 * dx / U)
nsteps = 3000

u = zeros(N, N);  v = zeros(N, N);  p = zeros(N, N)

function solve_pressure!(p, rhs, dx, dy; maxiter=100)
    for _ in 1:maxiter
        p_old = copy(p)
        for i in 2:(N-1), j in 2:(N-1)
            p[i,j] = 0.5 * ((p_old[i+1,j] + p_old[i-1,j]) * dy^2 +
                             (p_old[i,j+1] + p_old[i,j-1]) * dx^2 -
                             rhs[i,j] * dx^2 * dy^2) / (dx^2 + dy^2)
        end
        p[1,:] .= p[2,:];  p[N,:] .= p[N-1,:]
        p[:,1] .= p[:,2];  p[:,N] .= p[:,N-1]
    end
end

for step in 1:nsteps
    u_star = copy(u);  v_star = copy(v)
    for i in 2:(N-1), j in 2:(N-1)
        dudx = (u[i+1,j] - u[i-1,j]) / (2dx)
        dudy = (u[i,j+1] - u[i,j-1]) / (2dy)
        dvdx = (v[i+1,j] - v[i-1,j]) / (2dx)
        dvdy = (v[i,j+1] - v[i,j-1]) / (2dy)
        lapu = (u[i+1,j]-2u[i,j]+u[i-1,j])/dx^2 + (u[i,j+1]-2u[i,j]+u[i,j-1])/dy^2
        lapv = (v[i+1,j]-2v[i,j]+v[i-1,j])/dx^2 + (v[i,j+1]-2v[i,j]+v[i,j-1])/dy^2
        u_star[i,j] = u[i,j] + dt*(-(u[i,j]*dudx + v[i,j]*dudy) + ν*lapu)
        v_star[i,j] = v[i,j] + dt*(-(u[i,j]*dvdx + v[i,j]*dvdy) + ν*lapv)
    end
    u_star[:,1] .= 0; v_star[:,1] .= 0; u_star[:,N] .= U; v_star[:,N] .= 0
    u_star[1,:] .= 0; v_star[1,:] .= 0; u_star[N,:] .= 0; v_star[N,:] .= 0

    rhs = zeros(N, N)
    for i in 2:(N-1), j in 2:(N-1)
        rhs[i,j] = (1/dt)*((u_star[i+1,j]-u_star[i-1,j])/(2dx) +
                            (v_star[i,j+1]-v_star[i,j-1])/(2dy))
    end
    solve_pressure!(p, rhs, dx, dy)

    for i in 2:(N-1), j in 2:(N-1)
        u[i,j] = u_star[i,j] - dt*(p[i+1,j]-p[i-1,j])/(2dx)
        v[i,j] = v_star[i,j] - dt*(p[i,j+1]-p[i,j-1])/(2dy)
    end
    u[:,1] .= 0; v[:,1] .= 0; u[:,N] .= U; v[:,N] .= 0
    u[1,:] .= 0; v[1,:] .= 0; u[N,:] .= 0; v[N,:] .= 0
end

ω = zeros(N, N)
for i in 2:(N-1), j in 2:(N-1)
    ω[i,j] = (v[i+1,j]-v[i-1,j])/(2dx) - (u[i,j+1]-u[i,j-1])/(2dy)
end

xs = range(0, L, length=N);  ys = range(0, L, length=N)
speed = sqrt.(u.^2 .+ v.^2)

p1 = heatmap(xs, ys, speed', title="Speed |u⃗|", color=:turbo, aspect_ratio=1)
p2 = heatmap(xs, ys, ω', title="Vorticity ω", color=:RdBu, aspect_ratio=1,
             clims=(-maximum(abs.(ω)), maximum(abs.(ω))))
display(plot(p1, p2, layout=(1,2), size=(900,400)))
```

### Advection-Diffusion in Ocean Currents

Pollutant dispersal, nutrient transport, and larval connectivity in the ocean are governed by advection-diffusion equations — the same convection-diffusion PDE from Unit 3, applied to oceanographic contexts.

## 4.3 The Shallow Water Equations

### Governing Equations

The linearised shallow water equations are a coupled hyperbolic system for surface elevation $\eta$ and velocity $u$:

$$\frac{\partial \eta}{\partial t} + H \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = 0 \quad \text{(continuity)}$$
$$\frac{\partial u}{\partial t} + g \frac{\partial \eta}{\partial x} = 0 \quad \text{(momentum)}$$

with wave speed $c = \sqrt{gH}$. A Gaussian bump in $\eta$ splits into two counter-propagating waves — we will solve this with a PINN in Unit 8.
